name: Centripetal Force
formula: F_c = m * a_c = (m * v^2) / r = m * r * ω^2
description: F_c = Centripetal force, m = mass of the object, r = radius of the circle, v = linear velocity, ω = angular velocity, a_c = centripetal acceleration
